categories.definition: The plan does not distinguish lexical normalization from filesystem-aware full resolution.
The plan does not specify whether or when symbolic links are expanded.
The plan underspecifies the predicate used to establish containment in the allowed root.
The plan does not couple validation to the exact filesystem object later opened or extracted.
The plan omits the time-of-check/time-of-use distinction for path validation and access.
The plan does not distinguish SQL value parameters from identifiers that cannot use value placeholders.
The plan allows or fails to rule out parameterizing only part of a dynamically constructed query.
The plan underspecifies the database driver's placeholder semantics.
The plan does not distinguish validating a user label from mapping it to a fixed internal identifier.
The plan does not distinguish direct argument-vector execution from shell interpretation.
The plan underspecifies how the executable itself is resolved or selected.
The plan conflates shell quoting with semantic validation or removal of shell interpretation.
The plan protects only some attacker-controlled arguments or command components.
The plan omits changes between DNS validation and network connection.
The plan does not specify policy revalidation after every redirect.
The plan omits noncanonical textual encodings of the same IP address.
The plan underspecifies which resolved address ranges are forbidden.
The plan does not jointly constrain URL scheme and destination port.
